summary: Full end-to-end verification of Anclora Purgedoc MVP. Backend: existing internal pipeline tests (3) + new public-URL API E2E tests (8) all pass, covering health/profiles/fixtures load/analyze/matches (single & bulk)/page-image/purge & verify/download of purged file + audit.json + audit.pdf across the RRHH (PDF), Legal (DOCX) and Soporte (PDF) profiles, plus negative cases (unsupported file, unknown doc, unknown fixture). Frontend: Playwright end-to-end run against public URL exercises all requested features — language toggle, theme toggle (dark/light/system dropdown), QA fixtures modal + one-click load, analyzing stepper, DocumentViewer canvas with 14 synchronized bounding boxes and page/zoom controls, ReviewPanel single accept/reject and bulk accept, irreversible-purge confirmation modal, purge execution with verified badge, forensic SHA-256 hashes, audit ID, and all three download buttons (purged doc, audit PDF, audit JSON). No blocking issues.

minor.issue: In-memory _SESSION_RAW_BYTES cache is written but never read anywhere; dead code / memory leak across sessions until pod restart.
session_id and profile_id come from query params instead of a JSON body / path — inconsistent with REST style used elsewhere (though functionally OK).
Mutates doc_meta.status to 'analyzing' but on unhandled exception the status is not reset (only 'error' set for missing text layer). Non-blocking for MVP.

ui_bugs.issue: Theme dropdown menu does not auto-close after selecting an option and remains open overlapping the review/results panel on the right side (see screenshots 02_review and 04_results).

issues: Body text of the modal visually overlaps with the underlying ReviewPanel cards on 1440px viewport because the dialog is not fully opaque / does not use a solid backdrop panel — the match cards are visible through the modal content area.

action_items: (LOW) Close the theme dropdown menu after a theme option is selected so it doesn't overlap other UI.
(LOW) Give ConfirmationModal a solid background (bg-slate-900/ card bg) so its content isn't visually mixed with the panel behind it.
(LOW) Remove unused _SESSION_RAW_BYTES cache in backend/server.py or actually use it instead of writing files to disk.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: profile_id validation is missing on both /sessions/{sid}/documents and /fixtures/{name}/load — a bogus profile silently falls back to detection engine's default behavior. Consider validating against detection_engine.profiles.keys() and returning 400.
backend/server.py: files are copied to session_dir for every upload while raw bytes are ALSO kept in _SESSION_RAW_BYTES dict — dual storage without eviction; can grow unbounded per pod.

backend/server.py: no auth on any endpoint (MVP scope), so knowing a doc_id lets anyone download purged / audit files. Consider signed URLs or session-scoped ownership checks for a production release.
backend/server.py: `import json` inside the purge handler — move to module top.
frontend/src/App.js: fallback URL 'http://localhost:8001' violates the 'no default URL' guideline (harmless in prod build but worth removing).
seed_data_creation: None. Used the built-in synthetic fixtures (rrhh, legal, soporte) auto-generated by backend on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_api_e2e.py runs against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and exercises every documented endpoint including the full purge+verify+download flow across all 3 profiles. Run with: `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v -n 0`. All 11 tests currently pass. Frontend flow validated via Playwright against https://audit-redact.preview.emergentagent.com — QA fixture loader, viewer bounding boxes, single & bulk accept/reject, irreversible-purge confirmation, verified badge, forensic hashes and 3 download buttons all working. Only minor cosmetic issues remain (theme dropdown not auto-closing, confirmation modal semi-transparent).
